cards.text: Jesus is sitting on the Mount of Olives with four of His disciples: Peter, James, John and Andrew. They asked Him privately when the temple would be thrown down and what the sign would be. He's been warning them about false Christs and days of tribulation unseen since God made the world.
Now Jesus tells them what comes after that tribulation. And it starts WAY up in the sky.

cards.question: After that tribulation, what does Jesus say will happen to the sun?
With the sun darkened, Jesus says the moon will still give its light.

cards.text: Then Jesus gets to the stars. Friend, my night sky up here is still mostly empty, waiting on stars, so He has my FULL attention.

cards.question: What does Jesus say will happen to the stars?

answers.text: They will fall from the sky
They will shine like the sun
They will line up in a sign

cards.question: While all this happens in the sky, the powers of the heavens stay steady.

cards.text: Sun off, moon off, stars coming DOWN: that's darker than my old junk drawer, and I LIVED there. Then Jesus says what they will see.

cards.question: In all that dark, who does Jesus say they will see coming in the clouds?
The Son of Man comes quietly in the clouds, without any power or glory.

cards.text: Friend, it took ONE angel to get me out of ONE drawer. Here the Son of Man sends out the angels, plural.

cards.question: What does the Son of Man send the angels out to do?
The angels gather His elect from just one land.

cards.text: Then Jesus gives His disciples a lesson from a fig tree. Watch what its branches do.

cards.question: What do the fig tree's branches do that tells you a season is coming?

answers.text: They get tender and sprout leaves
They drop all of their fruit
They dry out and start to crack

cards.text: Friend, I couldn't grow a fig tree if you taped the seeds AND the instructions to my hat. But even I can read a leaf.

cards.question: As soon as the fig branches sprout leaves, you know that ___ is near.

cards.text: Then Jesus turns the lesson from the tree to the things He's been telling them about.

cards.question: When the disciples see these things happening, what does Jesus say they should know?

answers.text: He is near right at the door
They still have plenty of time

cards.question: The fig tree lesson teaches the disciples to read the signs the way people read the seasons.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, “Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.”
Next He puts His words up against heaven and earth. Friend, that's the sky, the ground, and my whole little cookie planet too.

cards.question: Heaven and earth will pass away. What does Jesus say about His words?

cards.text: Things wear out, friend, just ask my old edges. Then Jesus talks about that day and hour, and whether anybody knows when it comes.

cards.question: Who does Jesus say knows about that day or hour?
Jesus says not even the Son knows that day or hour.

cards.text: Sounds a whole lot like what the angel told me back in that drawer. That's why I don't guess dates up here, I just keep the ovens HOT.

cards.question: Since no one knows when the appointed time will come, what does Jesus tell His disciples to do?

answers.text: Be on guard and stay alert
Pick a date and get ready

cards.text: Then Jesus paints a picture: a man going on a journey leaves his house. Before he goes, he hands out jobs.

cards.question: Before the man leaves on his journey, what does he put each servant in charge of?
The man also tells the servant at the door, the doorkeeper, to keep ___.

cards.text: Now the master of the house is coming back, but nobody knows when. It's like waiting on a delivery with no tracking: the SECOND you hop in the shower, the doorbell rings.

cards.question: When might the master of the house come back?

answers.text: At noon on the seventh day

cards.text: And here's the part that gets me. It's not just WHEN the master shows up. It's what he finds when he walks in.

cards.question: If the master arrives without notice, what does Jesus warn he might find?

cards.text: The snooze button has beaten stronger folks than me, friend, and I'm a COOKIE STAMPER. Then Jesus gives His last word to the four disciples on that mountain.

cards.question: When Jesus says to keep watch, He means it only for Peter, James, John and Andrew.

cards.text: What He says to them, He says to everyone: “Keep watch!” Same in my bakery, friend: ovens warm, apron on, eyes OPEN.

findings.problem: The included parable Mark 13:34-36 doesn't have a stop of its own covering exactly those verses.

rule.text: An included parable or sermon (see passages.md) gets a stop of its own.

findings.problem: The choice cards follow a fixed formula: a story card, then a multiple choice card, then a true or false card that restates the same verse as a negative. This repeats four times (cards 2-4, 5-7, 8-10, 11-13). The stop has no fill in the blank card.

rule.text: No formula. Which question type comes next, the order the types come in and where a blank falls are chosen naturally for each card. They never follow a pattern. No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

findings.problem: This story card is only a joke about growing a fig tree. It tells no part of the passage and doesn't move it forward, but it still cites Mark 13:28.

rule.text: Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

findings.problem: Card 2's question says the branches tell you 'a season is coming.' That rules out the wrong answer 'the rain', which isn't a season. 'the rain' is also a different kind of thing from 'summer' and 'winter'.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: This story card is only Papa Dorin's commentary about the angel and his ovens. It tells no part of the passage, but it still cites Mark 13:32.

rule.text: Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

findings.problem: 'That's why I don't guess dates up here, I just keep the ovens HOT' comes right before card 8. It rules out the wrong answer 'Pick a date and get ready' and points to the right answer about staying alert.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: 'Before he goes, he hands out jobs' gives away the answer to card 2 ('His own task') and rules out 'A bag of silver' and 'A key to the house'.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: Card 4 says 'nobody knows when' the master comes back. That rules out the two wrong answers, which name exact times ('At noon on the seventh day', 'Right after the harvest ends'). The only open-ended answer stands out as right.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
